doc: Re-initializes three contiguous sound-slot tables (D_800869C0[16], D_80086A40[16], D_80086C00[16]) to default/free values, then resets a 0x1000 counter (D_80086D4C). Called by func_8005A428 at the end of its per-frame update as the "table re-init" step. First loop marks all 16 D_80086A40 slots free (marker=-1) and sets default volume/pan bytes (0x7F,0x7F,0x40) at offsets 0x19-0x1B. Second loop marks all 16 D_80086C00 sound slots free (field_0=-1, field_2=0, field_8=field_A=0x7F) and simultaneously zeroes the two words of the adjacent D_800869C0[16] table. Finally stores 0x1000 into D_80086D4C[0].
